title: Automation
intro: Jobs the portal does by itself every night at 03:00, and the notices it sends. Each switch and limit is a setting; every change is recorded in the audit log.

run.title: Daily run
run.never: The daily run hasn't run yet.
run.caption: What the last run did
run.busy: A run is already going; try again in a few minutes.

steps.waitlist: Waitlisted students placed in free seats

fields.autoPromoteWaitlist: Give freed seats to waitlisted students
fields.latePlacementDays: Days after the start a batch still takes students
fields.pendingReminderDays: Remind about applications waiting longer than (days)
fields.passportExpiryNoticeDays: Warn before a passport link expires (days)
fields.opportunityMatchPercent: Tell students about new opportunities they match at least (%)
fields.analyticsAutoRefreshMinutes: Refresh outcome analytics after certificates if older than (minutes)

hints.autoCloseAfterDays: A batch closes once every student has a decision and this many days have passed, so you can still change a decision first.
hints.latePlacementDays: Waitlisted students are placed in planned batches, and in running ones up to this many days after the start.
hints.pendingReminderDays: Admins get one reminder a day while older applications wait.
hints.placementFollowUpDays: Admins are asked whether the student is still in the job.
hints.passportExpiryNoticeDays: The student can share a new link before the old one stops working.
hints.opportunityMatchPercent: Sent when an opportunity is published, from verified skills.
hints.analyticsAutoRefreshMinutes: A bulk approval refreshes once, not once per student.

autoApproval: Automatic approval of applications has its own rules on the Enrollments page; when it is on, the daily run also applies them to applications already waiting.
